subject: Actual same-source double-separated overshoot pointwise classification
quantifiers: There exists universal C>0; for every actual standard Brownian B/PB, every n>=0, raw real labelled path a, x>=16, arbitrary permutation-indexed cap nu, rank r>=0 and permutation sigma; no iid law or stopping assumption is needed for the pointwise conclusion.

definitions.G: the exact actualDerivativeFamily Q from unit191 (same batch unqualified); halflineDerivative upper/lower and guarded intervalDerivative Q
definitions.U: sourceSeparatedOvershoot upper (G upper) a x nu r sigma
definitions.L: sourceSeparatedOvershoot lower (G lower) a x nu r sigma
definitions.I: sourceSeparatedOvershoot interval (G interval) a x nu r sigma
definitions.HU: forall k<=r, prefixSum(reorder a sigma) k < w; NO terminal endpoint in this prefix-only flag
definitions.HL: forall k<=r, -w < prefixSum(reorder a sigma) k; NO terminal endpoint in this prefix-only flag

sharpSubcases: Not Bad and HU and HL and interior z: upper first crossing OD=ec*(GI-GU), lower reflected analogue; ratio gives OD<=epsilon*(U+L).
Not Bad and HU and HL and exterior z: an active opposite-side crossing is impossible by actual |b|<=w/x and w>=x sqrt(T), so OD=0.
not HL with HU: L=I=0 and OD=U; not HU with HL: U=I=0 and OD=L; both dead gives OD=0.
r>=n, r>=nu, Q=0, T<=0, large energy, or no monitored crossing: relevant separated terms vanish literally; equality crossing e=0 retained.
